display.title: Episode 302: A Blessing From a Tzaddik (Conclusion)
display.summary_short: Saying good morning to Hashem with Modeh Ani and a new Modeh Ani song, a grandfather from Russia and his grandchildren in Studio 604, and the conclusion of 'A Blessing From a Tzaddik'.
display.summary_long: Broadcast in Cheshvan 5748. Uncle Yossi explains that Hashem guards us all night, welcomed into our bedroom by the mezuzah that never sleeps, and that each morning we say good morning to Him with the twelve words of Modeh Ani, thanking Him for returning our neshamah fresh and renewed. A new Modeh Ani song follows, then a lesson about always saying thank you. After the Hakochainik march to the Shabbos zemer Yom Zeh Mechubad, a grandfather recently arrived from Russia and his five grandchildren lead the Shema, and he blesses all children with nachas and an end to golus. Story time concludes 'A Blessing From a Tzaddik': the young-looking hotel keeper tells Reb Boruch that sixty years earlier he secretly swept the Baal Shem Tov's room at night but left the tzaddik's shoes untouched, and was blessed with long life. Now ninety, he still looks young, while the old-looking man he scolded is his own son. The show ends with Shabbos candle time and a call for letters about Tzivos Hashem rooms.
display.lesson: Start every day by thanking Hashem with Modeh Ani, say thank you to everyone, and treat tzaddikim and guests with great respect.
